resources.string: Hi! Ask me anything — what to watch tonight, a quick fact, or \"open YouTube\". I answer in English or Arabic. To talk instead of typing, press the phone button and scan the code with your phone.
The assistant uses OpenRouter\'s free models. Create a free key at openrouter.ai/keys, then add it in Settings › AI assistant.
OpenRouter rejected the API key. Check it in Settings › AI assistant.
OpenRouter reports a negative credit balance. Free models stop working until it is settled.
Free-model limit reached (requests per minute or per day). Try again later.
The request was blocked by the model\'s moderation.
No connection to OpenRouter. Check the network and try again.
The model sent an empty reply. Try again; the free router may pick another model.
OpenRouter could not answer right now. Try again.

Scan the code with the phone camera, or open the address in the phone\'s browser. The phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as the TV. Tap the microphone on the phone keyboard to dictate, then Send. The link stays open while this panel is open.
Enter the key from your phone
Scan the code with the phone camera, paste your OpenRouter key on the page and tap Send. It goes straight to this TV over your home network.
QR code with the phone link address
The TV has no Wi-Fi or Ethernet address on a home network. Connect it to your network first.
The phone link could not start because its network ports are in use. Try again in a moment.
Phone link closed after 10 minutes without use. Press the phone button to open it again.
Phone link closed because of a network error. Press the phone button to open it again.
Paste or type your key (starts with sk-or-). Easier: use Enter key from phone. From a computer you can also focus this field and run: adb shell input text YOUR_KEY
Saved. OpenRouter keys normally start with sk-or-.
API key removed from this TV.
Free key at openrouter.ai/keys. The key is stored only on this TV, excluded from Android backups, and sent only to openrouter.ai.
An OpenRouter model id, for example google/gemma-4-31b-it:free. Paid models use your OpenRouter credits.
openrouter/free picks a free model per request at no cost. Free models are rate limited by OpenRouter (per minute and per day).
Holding Menu opens the assistant in every app once quick actions are on (one-time ADB setup). Until then it works only while Lumora is open.

Hold the ☰ Menu button for about half a second to open the assistant; a short press still works as Menu. Works in every app with quick actions on, otherwise only inside Lumora. The Alexa button cannot be used: Fire OS sends it only to Alexa. For Alexa, see the Lumora Alexa skill guide.

Your questions, the recent conversation and (if on) the names of installed apps are sent to OpenRouter and the model provider it selects. Nothing else leaves the TV. With sharing off the assistant cannot suggest apps to open. The phone link works only inside your home network.
Updated every second while this page is open. Fire OS hides some figures (for example overall CPU load) from apps; the bar then shows the current clock speed instead.

Lets Lumora take screenshots, open the power menu, return to Lumora when the Home button opens the stock Fire TV home, and open the Lumora assistant when the Menu button is held. It looks only at the Menu button and does not read screen content.
Type the OpenRouter key from a computer
Open Settings › AI assistant › API key, focus the field, then run:\nadb shell input text sk-or-v1-…
